item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00034","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C19","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It has the same three-recital sequence identifying a railroad dispute, failure of Railway Labor Act adjustment, and the National Mediation Board's determination that interstate commerce and essential transportation are threatened. It then uses essentially identical operative provisions requiring a presidential report within thirty days and preserving the disputed conditions through the statutory cooling-off period. The later order primarily substitutes the carrier, unions, and geographic scope.
